notes.title: 『BRIGHT TRACER』ver1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]『BRIGHT TRACER』was updated to ver1.0.2[/b]
latest version details are below.

[b]【Functionality Update】[/b]
1：Pressing the Esc. key now opens the Pause menu.

2：The (Go Back)option can be accessed by the (Esc.)key as well as the (Backspace)key on the following screens:
 　-Credits
 　-Settings
 　-Stage Selection
 　-Dialogue

We look forward to your continued support.

notes.title: 『BRIGHT TRACER』 is now available for free on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44007777/4a33de8d9a551ad58f1467c981b8326b52da724b.png[/img]
[h2]The high speed running action game 『BRIGHT TRACER』 is available for free on Steam starting May 20th.[/h2]

[h3]”BRIGHT TRACER" is a high-speed running game to. Dash through a cyberspace world being invaded by a viruse.[/h3]
You stylishly advance through the stages stylishly using various actions such as wall-run and wire-hook. Run, jump, dodge enemies and obstacles through the world to get to the viruses’ boss.
This title was created for those who want to play a fast-paced responsive game. Enjoy the responsive dash as you run through stages non-stop with intuitive controls.

---
[b][u]A request from 『BRIGHT TRACER』:[/u][/b]
This game has been fully created by our newest developers from conception, to development, all the way to release. 

We encourage you to review the game as all encouragement and critique would help us a lot in our future endeavors. 
We await your reviews and impressions on Steam and Twitter.

Posting videos from the game to video sharing sites and social media, as well as streaming on streaming platforms is also allowed. Please refer to the guidelines [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SSn7C30V8-r2KBW9Bszdm47obWE4WPgQ/view?usp=sharing]here[/url] before posting, and enjoy your game.
